title: Letter Road Driving
shareTitle: Letter Road Driving 🚗 — Letter Shapes on Wheels
description: Help five cheerful car friends reach letter-linked destinations by tracing uppercase roads, then watch them drive the finished route.
learningGoals: Explore letter shapes through movement and direction
Control one continuous stroke through straight and curved letter forms
Follow numbered starts to learn uppercase multi-stroke order
interactionModel: strand-proof finger tracing with a translucent planning car, followed by an expressive solid-car drive replay
feedbackModel: Named missions, decorated destinations, gold lanes, sustained toy motor, arrival horn, A–Z full-body destination-action rewards, cloned teacher voice, and gentle spoken off-road guidance.

modes.title: Easy Roads
modes.skill: continuous control on single-stroke uppercase letter shapes
